name: com.vrctexturepainter.tool
description: Paint textures and shader masks directly on your avatar in the Scene view, like Blender's Texture Paint mode: hard, soft, blur, color blend and eraser brushes, Photoshop style layers, a mask painter whose red, green and blue masks add up in one texture, and 3D projection painting that stays correct across UV seams, mirrored UVs and multiple UV channels. Editor-only.
